thread:
ava: Quick UX review of compact dark dashboard — two things stood out: legend is chewing space and the mini-sparklines disappear on the panel inset. dropping a compact palette and a pattern idea.

marc: can you paste the css vars? want to try in the storybook.

ava: sure: `--bg:#0b0d10; --panel:#0f1113; --muted:#98a0a6; --brand:#59bfff; --spark:rgba(89,191,255,0.85); --heat-low:#46b7a8; --heat-mid:#ffd57a; --heat-high:#ff7458`

dee: sparkline alpha 0.85 helps. also for small heatmap cells pattern overlay (diagonal hatch) + color combo will make it readable for protanopes.

riley: agree on pattern. legend: collapse into a single icon that expands on hover in compact layout. saves vertical rhythm.

ava: plan: 1) bump sparkline alpha + subtle outer glow on hover, 2) add optional hatch pattern for heatmap cells (settings toggle), 3) swap legend to hover-expand for compact screens, 4) update tiny text contrast per a11y checklist.

design-bot: Story uploaded: https://figma.com/file/xyz-compact-dark-legend (ava/compact-legend-patterns)

marc: nice. copy tweak for settings: "Heatmap: Color + patterns (recommended)" — less clinical than 'color-blind mode'.

dee: add keyboard focus state for legend icon (3:1 visible ring). otherwise lgtm.

ava: thanks — I'll open a small PR with the css vars + storybook fixture and ping QA for contrast test results. :white_check_mark:
